# 百洑傳息｜Bioflumen & Xensor Lab

> An interdisciplinary research laboratory at National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU), Taiwan, led by Assistant Professor Chun-Hao Chang (張鈞豪). Research focuses on microfluidics, biosensing and in vitro diagnostics.

This is a factual directory of public website content. Updated 2026-10-09. The website presents Traditional Chinese and English together.

## Identity and contact
- Laboratory: 百洑傳息實驗室 / Bioflumen & Xensor Lab
- Principal investigator: 張鈞豪 / Chun-Hao Chang, Assistant Professor
- Department: 醫學生物技術暨檢驗學系 / Department of Biotechnology and Laboratory Science in Medicine
- University: 國立陽明交通大學 / National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University
- Email: jimhao@nycu.edu.tw
- Location: Room 223, Biomedical Engineering Building, No. 155, Sec. 2, Li-Nong St., Beitou District, Taipei 112, Taiwan

## Website sections
- [Lab philosophy](https://jimhaoch.github.io/#about): Fluid science, life science and signal technology.
- [Research](https://jimhaoch.github.io/#research): Exhaled breath condensate collection, acoustic microfluidics for sputum liquefaction, centrifugal live-bacteria detection and Au/SiC photocatalytic microfluidics.
- [Principal investigator](https://jimhaoch.github.io/#pi): Education, experience, expertise and official faculty profile.
- [Lab members](https://jimhaoch.github.io/#people): Master's students 鍾天晴、吳沛樺; undergraduate researchers 張修瑀、張育嘉、謝珺涵、劉名峻.
- [Publications](https://jimhaoch.github.io/#publications): Selected publications with DOI links.
- [Training and joining](https://jimhaoch.github.io/#join): Student training and inquiry information.
- [Questions](https://jimhaoch.github.io/#questions): Research topics, collaboration and joining inquiries.
- [Contact](https://jimhaoch.github.io/#contact): Industry–academia collaboration, research collaboration, joining the lab and student projects. The form requests name, email, organization, inquiry type and message.

## Research context
The four featured research stories describe work completed with the PI's participation before this lab was established. AI-generated conceptual illustrations are labeled on the website. Original paper figures and DOI-linked publications document exact device structures and experimental results.

## Selected publications
- [A Wearable Exhaled Breath Condensate (EBC) Collector with Controllable Condensation Microfluidics and a Branched Hydrophilic Film](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cej.2024.155994) (2024).
- [Development of a Vertical Bubble Acoustic Microfluidic Sputum Liquefier for Improved Cancer Cell Detection](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.snb.2023.134356) (2023).
- [Rapid Detection of Live Bacteria in Water Using Nylon Filter Membrane-Integrated Centrifugal Microfluidics](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.bios.2023.115403) (2023).
- [Au/SiC Microfluidic Devices Fabricated by Rapid Laser Cladding for Photocatalytic Degradation of Water Pollutants](https://doi.org/10.1021/acssuschemeng.3c07451) (2024).
- [Deep-UV Silicon Polaritonic Metasurfaces for Enhancing Biomolecule Autofluorescence and Two-Dimensional Material Double-Resonance Raman Scattering](https://doi.org/10.1002/adfm.202420439) (2025).
- [Hand-Powered Point-of-Care: Centrifugal Microfluidic Platform for Urine Routine Examination (μCUREX)](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.langmuir.2c02923) (2023).
- [NIR Laser Integration of Photodetector on 3D Printed Chamber for Colorimetric Biosensing](https://doi.org/10.1002/admt.202201026) (2023).
- [Hand-Powered Centrifugal Microfluidic Disc with Magnetic Chitosan Bead-Based ELISA for Antibody Quantitation](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.snb.2020.128003) (2020).
- [Rapid and Safe Isolation of Human Peripheral Blood B and T Lymphocytes through Spiral Microfluidic Channels](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-019-44677-3) (2019).
